text: ITEM 1 | Two cooked strips of reddish-brown meat with crisp golden-brown edges and translucent fatty streaks, lying in a loose overlapping tangle on a white square plate; strips are about 10-12 cm long and roughly 1-1.5 cm wide, with a slightly glossy, rendered sheen and visible wavy, layered texture; the bulk sits in the center-right of the plate, covering roughly 12-15% of the plate's surface, with a low, flat profile about 0.5-1 cm thick | 25
